services.value: Provides environmental lab testing and related services including asbestos testing/removal, lead testing/removal, air monitoring and sample analysis (PCM & TEM), bulk asbestos sample analysis (PLM & TEM), personal air sample analysis (PCM), hazardous waste characterizations, industrial wastewater monitoring, site investigation support, and petroleum hydrocarbon analysis/field sampling. Also offers environmental consulting including environmental chemistry/analytical chemistry, environmental consulting, industrial hygiene & indoor air quality, environmental safety consulting, environmental due diligence (Phase I/II assessments, transaction screens, soil vapor investigations, RIFS), environmental remediation, and regulatory compliance & permitting.
